title: Traders Put $3 Million on SpaceX Falling Into Earnings
speaker: tastylive host (Signal vs. Noise)

macro_themes.view: Earnings moved up to Tue Oct 20 after close, compressing vol into Oct 21 expiry; Tesla reports the next day, merger speculation.

calls.reason: Large put buying: $2.7M Oct 23 135 puts (IPO price), Nov 6 144 puts, 2DTE 146 puts; host expects a violent post-earnings move but calls direction a guess.
calls.quote: three existing bearish put trades... each express a different view of the same directional bias, which is lower

notes: Bias reflects options flow, not the host's own view (he says 'a total guess'). Spot quoted ~146-150; implied move ~$10.35. Analyst targets 230-275 mentioned.
